REPORT_URL="http://localhost:3003/api/health-report"
ALL_OK=true

echo "========================================="
echo "Starting Health Check: $(date)"
echo "========================================="

# 1. Check Services
PORT_3000_STATUS="DOWN"
PORT_3000_CODE="000"
PORT_8080_STATUS="DOWN"
PORT_8080_CODE="000"

# Check Port 3000
echo -n "Checking service on port 3000... "

    PORT_3000_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 3 http://$HOST:3000/ 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
    PORT_3000_STATUS="RUNNING"
    echo "RUNNING (HTTP Status: $PORT_3000_CODE)"
else
    echo "DOWN"
    ALL_OK=false

# Check Port 8080
echo -n "Checking service on port 8080... "
if (echo > /dev/tcp/$HOST/8080) >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PORT_8080_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 3 http://$HOST:8080/ 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
    PORT_8080_STATUS="RUNNING"
    echo "RUNNING (HTTP Status: $PORT_8080_CODE)"
else
    echo "DOWN"
    ALL_OK=false
fi

# 2. Verify Configuration Presence (Locally)
# We check if the keys exist in .env.test without exposing their sensitive values.
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
DB_URL_CONF="false"
AWS_ID_CONF="false"
AWS_KEY_CONF="false"
ANTHROPIC_CONF="false"
STRIPE_CONF="false"
LOGFIRE_CONF="false"

    echo "Verifying configuration file presence..."
    grep -q "^DATABASE_URL=" "$ENV_FILE" && DB_URL_CONF="true"
    grep -q "^AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=" "$ENV_FILE" && AWS_ID_CONF="true"
    grep -q "^AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=" "$ENV_FILE" && AWS_KEY_CONF="true"
    grep -q "^ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=" "$ENV_FILE" && ANTHROPIC_CONF="true"
    grep -q "^STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=" "$ENV_FILE" && STRIPE_CONF="true"
    grep -q "^LOGFIRE_TOKEN=" "$ENV_FILE" && LOGFIRE_CONF="true"
else
    echo "Warning: $ENV_FILE not found."
    ALL_OK=false
fi

# Determine overall status

if [ "$ALL_OK" = false ]; then
    OVERALL_STATUS="FAILURE"
fi

# 3. Construct JSON Payload (Excluding sensitive credential values)
JSON_PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "status": "$OVERALL_STATUS",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")",
  "services": {
    "port_3000": {
      "status": "$PORT_3000_STATUS",

    "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_configured": $AWS_ID_CONF,
    "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_configured": $AWS_KEY_CONF,
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_configured": $ANTHROPIC_CONF,
    "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_configured": $STRIPE_CONF,
    "LOGFIRE_TOKEN_configured": $LOGFIRE_CONF
  }
}
EOF
)

# 4. Send Report to Monitoring Dashboard
echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
HTTP_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD" \
    "$REPORT_URL" 2>/dev/null || echo "000")

if [ "$HTTP_RESPONSE" = "200" ] || [ "$HTTP_RESPONSE" = "201" ]; then
    echo "Report successfully sent (HTTP $HTTP_RESPONSE)."
else
    echo "Warning: Failed to send report to dashboard (HTTP $HTTP_RESPONSE)."
fi

echo "========================================="
if [ "$ALL_OK" = true ]; then
    echo "Status: SUCCESS"
    exit 0
else
    echo "Status: FAILURE"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are running.

# Define ports to check
PORTS=(3000 8080)
ALL_OK=true

echo "========================================="
echo "Starting Health Check..."
echo "Timestamp: $(date)"
echo "========================================="

for PORT in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  # Use curl to check if the port is responding.
  # --connect-timeout 3: wait at most 3 seconds for connection
  # -s: silent mode
  # -o /dev/null: discard output
  curl -s --connect-timeout 3 -o /dev/null "http://localhost:${PORT}"
  STATUS=$?

  if [ $STATUS -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Port ${PORT}: RUNNING (Responded successfully)"
  else
    # Check if we can connect via /dev/tcp as a fallback
    if (timeout 3 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/${PORT}") 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "Port ${PORT}: RUNNING (TCP connection successful)"
    else
      echo "Port ${PORT}: DOWN (Connection failed, curl exit code: $STATUS)"
      ALL_OK=false
    fi
  fi
done

echo "========================================="
if [ "$ALL_OK" = true ]; then
  echo "Status: ALL SERVICES ARE RUNNING"
  exit 0
else
  echo "Status: ONE OR MORE SERVICES ARE DOWN"
  exit 1
fi
